what: Installation weeks, VERTICAL pair: ≥ 3 nights of cosmics with the full trigger. Measures the arm-to-arm time of flight (σ_t), each arm's MIP gain and the rejection of every cosmic veto, in the worst geometry

Roll to the HORIZONTAL pair. Beam on target at low current; current scan 0.05 → 1 µA (~2 h): trigger rates, DREAM live time, Micromegas occupancy, singles; γ-yield reference; then ~6 h in the 18.15 MeV region
H₂⁺ at 0.883 MV (two 0.441 MeV protons), IF the CN can provide it: 17.64 MeV M1 IPC, ~46 selected pairs in 8 h (rate to ~18 %), opening-angle shape and energy scale. Otherwise this day is at 1.10 MeV
18.15 MeV region: IPC spectrum, X17 window (40 h; 46 h with day 1 = 1.9 days of beam); γ-yield check each day
Arms ADJACENT (90°): small-angle IPC and external conversions (~500 pairs in 8 h)
Every night and the weekend without beam: cosmics with the full trigger in the physics geometry (~45 selected pairs per 16-hour night)
